description: Create a new TSO avatar for the currently authenticated user. The bot must be running in --chargen-mode (city-connected, no lot joined). Sends RSGZWrapperPDU on the city Voltron socket and awaits CreateASimResponse. On SUCCESS the server writes a new fso_avatars row and returns the new avatar_id. Only valid for sessions where the user has no avatar yet (or fewer than the per-account limit). Wire constraint: head_guid and body_guid are the high 32 bits of the TSO catalog OutfitID (the same uint32 the server stores in ValidMaleOutfits / ValidFemaleOutfits dict keys). Validation is engine-side: invalid GUIDs → ok:false reason:invalid-guid. Name collision → ok:false reason:name-taken.

args.name: first_name
args.description: Avatar first name. Must start with a letter, contain only letters and spaces, 3-24 chars. Engine validates.

args.name: last_name
args.description: Avatar last name. Same validation rules as first_name. Full name = first_name + ' ' + last_name.

args.name: description
args.description: Avatar bio / description. Max 499 printable ASCII chars. Defaults to empty string.

args.name: gender
args.description: Gender: 'M' or 'F' (case-insensitive). Determines which head/body catalog the engine validates against.

args.name: head_guid
args.description: Head outfit ID — the high 32 bits of the TSO OutfitID (uint32). Must be a valid entry in the ea_male_heads.col or ea_female_heads.col catalog matching the chosen gender.

args.name: body_guid
args.description: Body outfit ID — the high 32 bits of the TSO OutfitID (uint32). Must be a valid entry in the ea_male.col or ea_female.col catalog matching the chosen gender.

call_signatures: cf $CF create-avatar --first_name Vivi --last_name Romero --gender F --skin_tone light --head_guid 399 --body_guid 1192 --description 'A bright spark in Alphaville.'
common_mistakes: Passing the full 64-bit OutfitID instead of the high 32 bits. head_guid=4075923963917 is wrong; head_guid=949 is correct (4075923963917 >> 32).
Using a head GUID for the body slot or vice versa — the server validates against separate head/body catalogs.
Calling create-avatar when the bot is in normal (lot-joined) mode — the bot must be launched with --chargen-mode.
Reusing a first_name+last_name that already exists in fso_avatars — the engine returns reason:name-taken.
refuse_conditions: head_guid or body_guid is 0 or missing → ok:false
engine validation failed → ok:false, reason in category:name-taken|invalid-guid|engine-refused
